title: Unsigned Kestrel Auto Finance Approvals: Expiry and Withdrawal
content:
An approval for Kestrel Auto Finance Retail Installment Contracts that is not signed by the end of its approval expiration date lapses to expired. A new application is then required, decided on the applicant's credit at that time.

A borrower may withdraw an unsigned approval at any time, and an approval is withdrawn when the purchase order it was written for is cancelled before signing.

Withdrawn and expired approvals carry no balance and no fees.

## At a glance

| Situation | Approval becomes | Balance and fees |
|---|---|---|
| Not signed by the end of the approval expiration date | expired | none |
| Borrower withdraws before signing | withdrawn | none |
| Purchase order cancelled before signing | withdrawn | none |

## Basis Q&A

**Can an expired approval be revived for signing?** No. A new application is required, and it is decided on the applicant's credit at that time.

**When may a borrower withdraw?** At any time while the approval is unsigned.
